callout-demo.firstParagraph:
Callouts use the Obsidian `> [!type]` syntax and are rendered with matching
CSS classes for visual emphasis.
callout-demo.title: Callout demo

embed-demo.firstParagraph:
Image embeds use Obsidian's `![[filename]]` syntax. The build pipeline resolves
the filename against `src/content/notes/_assets/` and emits an optimised
`<Picture>` element via Astro's asset pipeline.
embed-demo.summary: Demonstrates image embed syntax using the Obsidian ![[image]] notation.
embed-demo.title: Embed demo

math-demo.summary: Demonstrates KaTeX inline and display math rendering.
math-demo.title: Math demo

orphan.firstParagraph:
This note has no outgoing wikilinks. It exists to ensure the garden renders
correctly when a note is not connected to any other note in the graph.
orphan.summary: A note with no outgoing wikilinks, exercising the empty-backlinks render path.
orphan.title: Orphan

welcome.firstParagraph: This is the seed of the garden. Notes link to each other via [[Wikilinks]].
welcome.summary: Entry point for the digital garden.
welcome.title: Welcome

wikilinks.firstParagraph: This note links to [[Welcome]] and [[Math demo]] — both are resolved targets.
wikilinks.summary: Demonstrates resolved and broken wikilink rendering.
wikilinks.title: Wikilinks
